scope: Diagnostic controls, not accepted production gates.
inactive_controls: Shell-prefix DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES followed by the system python3 loses the loader variable before the Python process runs. Verified by inspecting presence only. Earlier malloc, wait-pool and allocation shell-launched probes did not establish hook activation and cannot support causal conclusions. Their production failures remain ordinary failed outcomes.
active_controls: Set DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES inside the running Python process before spawning the owned inference server. allocation-probe loaded markers appear for both listener and model worker, and per-allocation stacks are present.
large_allocation_observation: 64 allocations of 28,753,920 bytes and 48 of 9,437,184 bytes in the small AV1 case. Stack includes maintained termite_metal_buffer_alloc; nearest stripped Zig symbol offsets are not precise function attribution.
source_finding: Owned HF vision frames completed without retiring cached MPS activation views. Backbone layers already retire them. New code invokes the same retirement after an owned vision frame; external frame ownership is preserved. Numerical/device and production verification are required.
